verdict.summary: The advisory-disposition tripwire is correctly scoped as a staleness check rather than a vulnerability scanner. It enforces exact lock-instance path sets, recorded versions, dependency-field/range pins, and root overrides; parse failures fail closed. The focused hermetic suite exercises each claimed drift class plus the committed live inputs, and all 25 tests pass. The workflow runs the self-test before the live gate, while the documentation consistently preserves Dependabot as the advisory source and avoids suppressing alerts. No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found.
